# Dive Into Python

> Free Python tutorials, guides, and Mark Pilgrim's comprehensive book for learning Python programming from beginner to advanced levels.

Dive Into Python is a community-driven learning platform offering step-by-step tutorials, installation guides, and free educational resources for Python developers of all skill levels. The site provides structured lessons on core Python concepts, from variables and functions to object-oriented programming and file handling.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Mark Pilgrim
- beginner-guide
- python-basics
- python-syntax
- python-modules
- functions
- classes
- loops

- regular expressions

- free-resources
- python-book

## Getting Started

- [Dive into Python: Free Tutorials, Books to Learn Python](https://diveintopython.org): Homepage offering free Python tutorials and Mark Pilgrim's book
- [Learn Python Programming - Dive Into Python](https://diveintopython.org/learn): Main learning hub with step-by-step Python tutorials and examples
- [How to Install and Run Python: A Beginner's Guide](https://diveintopython.org/learn/install): Installation guide for Python on Windows, macOS, and Linux

## Python Fundamentals

- [Variable in Python - Variable Types, Definition, Naming Convention](https://diveintopython.org/learn/variables): Guide to Python variables, data types, and naming conventions
- [Introduction into Python Statements: Assignment, Conditional Examples](https://diveintopython.org/learn/statements): Tutorial on Python statements: assignment, conditional, and control flow
- [For and While Loops in Python, Syntax of Break and Continue Statements](https://diveintopython.org/learn/loops): Tutorial on for/while loops, break, continue, and loop control
- [Functions in Python: Arguments, Definition, Higher-order Functions Examples](https://diveintopython.org/learn/functions): Guide to Python functions, lambda, and functional programming

## Advanced Python Concepts

- [OOP in Python: How to Create a Class, Inherit Properties and Methods](https://diveintopython.org/learn/classes): Tutorial on OOP concepts: classes, inheritance, polymorphism
- [What is a Module in Python? Step-by-Step Guide How to Use Modules](https://diveintopython.org/learn/modules): Guide to Python modules, imports, and creating custom modules
- [How to Work with Files in Python: Reading, Writing, and File Operations](https://diveintopython.org/learn/file-handling): Guide to file operations: reading, writing, and file modes
- [RegEx in Python: Match and Replace Basics with Examples](https://diveintopython.org/learn/regex): Tutorial on regex pattern matching and text processing with re module
- [Date and Time Variables in Python: Format and Convert Examples](https://diveintopython.org/learn/date): Tutorial on datetime, time, calendar, and dateutil modules

## Learning Resources

- [Dive Into Python](https://book.diveintopython.org): Free Dive Into Python book by Mark Pilgrim in multiple formats
- [Python Developer Jobs - Your Next Career Move Starts Here](https://diveintopython.org/jobs): Python developer job listings and career resources

## International Resources

- [Inicio - Dive Into Python](https://diveintopython.org/es): Spanish language homepage for Python tutorials and resources
- [Dive Into Python: Книги для изучения Python](https://diveintopython.org/ru): Russian language homepage for Python learning and book resources
